item.title: Another summer surge leads to record highs
item.description: Springfield is expecting a warm end to March with record-setting temperatures, windier conditions, and increased fire danger, followed by a wet and stormy first half of April.

item.title: Man identified after Springfield pedestrian crash on I-44
item.description: One person was killed in a fatal pedestrian crash on I-44 near Kansas Expressway early Thursday morning, causing significant delays in the area.

item.title: Lebanon's Elm Street rebrands for Route 66 centennial
item.description: The City of Lebanon has officially renamed Elm Street to Route 66, effective April 1, in honor of the historic highway and in preparation for the Route 66 Centennial in 2026.

item.title: Springfield man sentenced for stealing $12,000 bronze statue from resident’s yard
item.description: Kenneth John Lowry Jr. was sentenced to 10 years in prison for stealing a $12,000 bronze statue from a Springfield resident's garden.

item.title: Bench trial set for Strafford woman charged with murder
item.description: Carlie Roberts pleaded not guilty to the second-degree murder of her husband, Dustin Roberts, and a bench trial has been set for July 28.

item.title: Additional tornadoes confirmed from March 15 storms
item.description: The Springfield NWS Office confirmed two additional tornadoes from the March 15th storm, bringing the total to six confirmed tornadoes in the area.

item.title: Ending the week with wind, warmth, and another round of storms
item.description: This week has featured warmth and the threat of storms, with severe weather kept to a minimum, and a cold front bringing gusty winds and a chance of isolated showers on Friday, followed by a chance of severe storms Friday night and patchy frost on Easter Sunday.
